meta.name: google-cloud-recipe-auth
meta.description: Provides expert guidance on authenticating and authorizing to Google Cloud services and APIs, covering human users, service identities, Application Default Credentials (ADC), and best practices for secure access.

copy.tagline: 安全访问谷歌云服务和API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为谷歌云配置用户或服务身份认证。
copy.tagline_en: Securely access Google Cloud services and APIs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure authentication for Google Cloud users or service identities.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你如何向 Google Cloud 进行身份验证和授权，涵盖用户、服务账号、ADC 等，并给出最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你询问如何访问 Google Cloud API、运行本地脚本或部署应用时，Claude 会主动提供认证方案。

say.text: 我如何在本地 Python 脚本中认证 Google Cloud？
say.note: Claude 会建议使用 ADC 或服务账号模拟。

say.text: Cloud Run 服务如何安全访问 Cloud SQL？
say.note: Claude 会指导附加服务账号并授予角色。

say.text: 我的应用在 AWS 上，如何调用 Google Cloud API？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you on authenticating and authorizing to Google Cloud services and APIs, covering human users, service accounts, ADC, and best practices for secure access.
howto.when_en: When you ask about accessing Google Cloud APIs, running local scripts, or deploying applications, Claude will provide authentication guidance.

say_en.text: How do I authenticate to Google Cloud from a local Python script?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using ADC or service account impersonation.

say_en.text: How can a Cloud Run service securely access Cloud SQL?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to attach a service account and grant roles.

say_en.text: My app is on AWS, how do I call Google Cloud APIs?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend Workload Identity Federation.
